verdict.rationale: Bento exposes subscribers/segments/tags APIs, workflows/sequences, and broadcast history via API, CLI (50+ commands), and an official MCP server that can 'look up subscribers, create broadcasts, track events' in natural conversation, which together let an agent pull audiences and automations programmatically. However, campaign-results reporting is thinly evidenced — only a general claim of tying revenue to emails/flows, with no explicit analytics/metrics endpoint or independent hands-on report confirming an agent can synthesize 'what's working.' Missing for 10: a documented reporting/analytics API surface for opens/clicks/revenue per campaign, and independent/hands-on validation of an agent performing this full workflow end-to-end.
